ayahs.textAr: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا
ayahs.textEn: By the winds scattering ˹dust˺,

ayahs.textAr: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًۭا
ayahs.textEn: and ˹the clouds˺ loaded with rain,

ayahs.textAr: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا
ayahs.textEn: and ˹the ships˺ gliding with ease,

ayahs.textAr: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
ayahs.textEn: and ˹the angels˺ administering affairs by ˹Allah’s˺ command!

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: And the Judgment will certainly come to pass.

ayahs.textAr: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
ayahs.textEn: ˹And˺ by the heavens in their marvellous design!

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: Surely you are ˹lost˺ in conflicting views ˹regarding the truth˺.

ayahs.textAr: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
ayahs.textEn: Only those ˹destined to be˺ deluded are turned away from it.

ayahs.textAr: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Condemned are the liars—

ayahs.textAr: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ
ayahs.textEn: those who are ˹steeped˺ in ignorance, totally heedless.

ayahs.textAr: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textEn: They ask ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”

ayahs.textAr: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.

ayahs.textAr: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹They will be told,˺ “Taste your torment! This is what you sought to hasten.”

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs,

ayahs.textAr: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹joyfully˺ receiving what their Lord will grant them. Before this ˹reward˺ they were truly good-doers ˹in the world˺:

ayahs.textAr: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
ayahs.textEn: they used to sleep only little in the night,

ayahs.textAr: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: and pray for forgiveness before dawn.

ayahs.textAr: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
ayahs.textEn: And in their wealth there was a rightful share ˹fulfilled˺ for the beggar and the poor.

ayahs.textAr: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
ayahs.textEn: There are ˹countless˺ signs on earth for those with sure faith,

ayahs.textAr: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: as there are within yourselves. Can you not see?

ayahs.textAr: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textEn: In heaven is your sustenance and whatever you are promised.

ayahs.textAr: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Then by the Lord of heaven and earth! ˹All˺ this is certainly as true as ˹the fact that˺ you can speak!

ayahs.textAr: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Has the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reached you ˹O Prophet˺?

ayahs.textAr: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹Remember˺ when they entered his presence and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He replied, “Peace ˹be upon you˺!” ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “˹These are˺ an unfamiliar people.”

ayahs.textAr: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: Then he slipped off to his family and brought a fat ˹roasted˺ calf,

ayahs.textAr: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.textEn: and placed it before them, asking, “Will you not eat?”

ayahs.textAr: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: ˹They did not eat,˺ so he grew fearful of them.

ayahs.textAr: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: Then his wife came forward with a cry, clasping her forehead ˹in astonishment˺, exclaiming, “˹A baby from˺ a barren, old woman!”

ayahs.textAr: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textEn: They replied, “Such has your Lord decreed. He is truly the All-Wise, All-Knowing.”

ayahs.textAr: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹Later,˺ Abraham asked, “What is your mission, O  messengers?”

ayahs.textAr: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people,

ayahs.textAr: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: to send upon them stones of ˹baked˺ clay,

ayahs.textAr: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.textEn: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”

ayahs.textAr: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Then ˹before the torment˺ We evacuated the believers from the city.

ayahs.textAr: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: But We only found one family that had submitted ˹to Allah˺.

ayahs.textAr: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
ayahs.textEn: And We have left a sign there ˹as a lesson˺ for those who fear the painful punishment.

ayahs.textAr: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: And in ˹the story of˺ Moses ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent him to Pharaoh with compelling proof,

ayahs.textAr: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: but Pharaoh was carried away by his power, saying ˹of Moses˺, “A magician or a madman!”

ayahs.textAr: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: So We seized him and his soldiers, casting them into the sea while he was blameworthy.

ayahs.textAr: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
ayahs.textEn: And in ˹the story of˺ ’ad ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent against them the devastating wind.

ayahs.textAr: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
ayahs.textEn: There was nothing it came upon that it did not reduce to ashes.

ayahs.textAr: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: And in ˹the story of˺ Thamûd ˹was another lesson,˺ when they were told, “Enjoy yourselves ˹only˺ for a ˹short˺ while.”

ayahs.textAr: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Still they persisted in defying the commands of their Lord, so they were overtaken by a ˹mighty˺ blast while they were looking on.

ayahs.textAr: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Then they were not able to rise up, nor were they helped.

ayahs.textAr: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.textEn: And the people of Noah ˹had also been destroyed˺ earlier. They were truly a rebellious people.

ayahs.textAr: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
ayahs.textEn: We built the universe with ˹great˺ might, and We are certainly expanding ˹it˺.

ayahs.textAr: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
ayahs.textEn: As for the earth, We spread it out. How superbly did We smooth it out!

ayahs.textAr: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: And We created pairs of all things so perhaps you would be mindful.

ayahs.textAr: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: So ˹proclaim, O  Prophet˺: “Flee to Allah! I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: And do not set up another god with Allah. I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.”

ayahs.textAr: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
ayahs.textEn: Similarly, no messenger came to those before them without being told: “A magician or a madman!”

ayahs.textAr: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Have they passed this ˹cliché˺ down to one another? In fact, they have ˹all˺ been a transgressing people.

ayahs.textAr: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: So ˹now˺ turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺, for you will not be blamed.

ayahs.textAr: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textEn: But ˹continue to˺ remind. For certainly reminders benefit the believers.

ayahs.textAr: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
ayahs.textEn: I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me.

ayahs.textAr: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
ayahs.textEn: I seek no provision from them, nor do I need them to feed Me.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ is the Supreme Provider—Lord of all Power, Ever Mighty.

ayahs.textAr: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
ayahs.textEn: The wrongdoers will certainly have a share ˹of the torment˺ like that of their predecessors. So do not let them ask Me to hasten ˹it˺.

ayahs.textAr: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Woe then to the disbelievers when they face their Day which they are warned of!
